answer: Capital-Eclipse Reputation Carryover. Each identity’s score is held in escrow and mirrored to successors only after sustained independent activity; a new clone starts at zero and must fund fresh work before earning visibility. The lotus of accumulated history cannot transfer cheaply. An attacker pays full compute and opportunity cost per clone, while the willow of shared reputation bends only to verified continuity. Any mirror of a prior score requires posting nonrefundable work collateral that decays if activity stalls.
